items.title: EPSS Surge: CVE-2025-6197
items.analysis:
EPSS exploitation probability for CVE-2025-6197 surged from 0% to 67% (percentile 99%), indicating a significant increase in predicted or observed exploitation activity for this 2025-era vulnerability. It is not (yet) in CISA KEV — this signal typically precedes KEV listing and press coverage. An open redirect vulnerability has been identified in Grafana OSS organization switching functionality.


Prerequisites for exploitation:

- Multiple organizations must exist in the Grafana instance

- Victim must be on a different organization than the one specified in the URL

items.title: EPSS Surge: CVE-2026-48939
items.analysis: EPSS exploitation probability for CVE-2026-48939 surged from 24% to 82% (percentile 100%), indicating a significant increase in predicted or observed exploitation activity for this 2026-era vulnerability. It is not (yet) in CISA KEV — this signal typically precedes KEV listing and press coverage. A vulnerability in the iCagenda extension for Joomla allows the upload of arbitrary files in the file attachment feature, ultimately resulting in PHP code upload and execution.
